name: iOS Release
notes: Builds go through manage_build; manage_editor has no build action. The `target` field above is Unity's BuildTarget name, while manage_build's `target` param takes the bridge alias (`ios`) -- see bridgeCall. IL2CPP is required on iOS; `scripting_backend` accepts only `mono` or `il2cpp` and there is no `coreclr` value. The `options` array accepts only clean_build, auto_run, deep_profiling, compress_lz4, strict_mode and detailed_report -- `Lz4HC` is NOT in that vocabulary and must be set in Build Settings or a Build Profile. Unity 6.4: the runtime libraries moved to XcodeFolder/Frameworks/UnityRuntime.framework/UnityRuntime (a static framework for both device and simulator), so any Xcode post-processing script that hard-codes the old Libraries/ path breaks. Unity 6.4 also removed PVRTC -- iOS textures must use ASTC or ETC. Sources: https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/whats-new/unity64 and https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/upgrade-guides/upgrade-guide-unity64, retrieved 2026-10-21.
